status: Read-only TYPE25 reader/starter/source audit; no solver changes or new solves

source_findings.finding: Igap3 mesh-limited upper bound uses 0.4 times MINIMUM nonzero edge length of each surface quadrilateral; it does not use maximum edge or depth25 as a fixed contact thickness.
Secondary nodal gap accumulator WA starts zero and receives shell/beam/truss/spring thickness contributions, no brick thickness contribution. Thus these pure-brick surfaces have GAP_S=0.
If no shell thickness exists (NDX=0) and no prescribed minimum gap, GAPMIN=0.
I25INI_GAP_N explicitly sets WA=0 for MSEGTYP=0 solid segments, then rebuilds all main nodal/segment gaps. Thus pure-brick main nodal gaps are zero.
Solid-surface edge physical gaps GAPE are max of adjacent GAP_M (zero here); GAP_E_L is an upper limit derived from minimum adjacent nodal mesh size.
Internal solid facets receive negative stiffness tag; V/AREA stored during stiffness processing is not evidence of a physical25mm contact gap. Main gap arrays are rebuilt later by I25INI_GAP_N.

conclusions: The hypothesized fixed or automatic physical gap of0.4*25=10mm is not supported; source derives zero physical thickness gap for the all-brick models and a separate mesh-based upper cap.
The1e30 printed values are maximum caps, not the physical contact gap.

This audit does not qualify contact penalty, initial-overlap treatment, runtime edge/margin search, post-erosion contact or large-deformation penetration. It only rules out the proposed bulkZdepth contact-thickness mechanism in the inspected initialization branches.
